candidates.title: Five-year-old dies in rockfall on Kedarnath route; around 1,000 pilgrims rescued
candidates.excerpt: A five-year-old boy died after being struck by a falling stone near Chirbasa on Uttarakhand’s Kedarnath trekking route. Rockfall debris blocked the route, prompting rescue operations for stranded pilgrims. Char Dham Yatra remained suspended amid heavy rainfall and weather alerts

candidates.title: LPU protest turns violent; stones pelted; vehicles set on fire, classes suspended; university releases video | 6 points
candidates.excerpt: Students of Lovely Professional University (LPU) in Phagwara went on a rampage on the campus and clashed with police on Sunday, vandalising property and blocking a stretch of the New Delhi-Amritsar highway outside their campus.

candidates.title: 'Shopping for free': Students loot LPU campus mall; torch computer science block
candidates.excerpt: Several videos from Lovely Professional University show students reportedly taking items from shops during protests. The protests were sparked by allegations surrounding the rape of a female student and a student's suicide. Police reported clashes, stone-pelting, and damage to property during the unrest, escalated by social media rumors. An investigation has been initiated, while the university has denied the rape allegations as false.

candidates.title: Amid concerns over Russia sanctions law, Foreign Secretary meets U.S. delegation
candidates.excerpt: Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri raised the new law with the delegation, most of whom voted in favour of sanctions targeting India for importing Russian crude oil
